content.title: National Burrito Day Deals: Where to Find Free Burritos and Deals Next Year
content.text: Burrito lovers across the country celebrate National Burrito Day with freebies and discounts from their favorite burrito makers. From top national chains like Moe's Southwest Grill and Qdoba, to local favorites like Chronic Tacos and El Pollo Loco, you’ve got lots of options for getting your burrito fix on the cheap. Whether your go-to is a classic bean and cheese burrito or a loaded carne asada burrito, National Burrito Day has deals ranging from freebies with purchase to discounted entrees. Here are all the deals we expect to see for National Burrito Day 2027. And if you're looking for other food deals, we have those too: Monday food deals, Tuesday food deals, and Friday food deals, plus more. Download the FREE KCL App What's on this page: What Is National Burrito Day? When Is the Next One? Predicted National Burrito Day Deals 2027 Offers, prices, savings, and local participation may vary. National Burrito Day is a 1-day event with free and cheap burritos. On National Burrito Day, restaurants across the country roll out deals on everyone's favorite handheld meal. From chains like Qdoba to local favorites such as El Pollo Loco, there's something for every burrito lover. Whether it's free burrito giveaways, BOGO offers, or hefty discounts, there are a lot of National Burrito Day deals. The next National Burrito Day will happen on Friday, April 2, 2027. National Burrito Day always takes place on the first Thursday in April, and in 2027 that will be Friday, April 2. Although the word burrito directly translates to “little donkey,” it’s said that they were named after the bundles that appear on donkeys’ bedrolls. Predicted National Burrito Day Deals 2027 Baja Fresh Mexican Grill: For National Burrito Day in 2027, Baja Fresh will likely celebrate with discounted burritos. Rewards members can anticipate a National Burrito Day exclusive offer in your rewards account. Bubbakoo's Burritos: Look for Bubbakoo's Burritos to offer rewards members BOGO burritos on National Burrito Day next year when you use a promo code during online or in-app checkout. Chipotle: We predict Chipotle will celebrate National Burrito Day with a BOGO Burritos giveaway for rewards members. Look for the game to run from 9 a.m. - 9 p.m. ET each day, March 30 through April 1. Here are the rules you can expect next year: to play, you must visit UnlockBurritoToday.com. Once there, you need to guess the correct burrito combination to unlock the Burrito Vault. Heads up — the burrito combination changes every hour. The first person to unlock the Burrito Vault each hour will walk away with a year's worth of FREE burritos. Then the next 3,600 people to unlock the vault will win a BOGO entree reward. This year, Chipotle will also have a random Double Protein Hour each day where the number of prizes and protein are doubled. The first two players to unlock the vault will win free double protein burritos for a year, then the next 7,200 winners will get a BOGO double protein burritos reward, and finally 4,000 double protein rewards will be awarded. Chipotle: Enjoy free delivery on National Burrito Day orders at Chipotle when you order online or in-app. Chronic Tacos: Next year, Chronic Tacos will likely offer loyalty members BOGO free burritos (excluding the California Burrito and Surf & Turf Burrito) through the Chronic Tacos app. Del Taco: We anticipate Del Taco will celebrate National Burrito Day in 2027 by giving Del Yeah Rewards members a free burrito with a purchase. Dog Haus: Rewards members can look forward to a BOGO reward for Dog Haus' Bad-Ass Breakfast Burritos when you purchase a Haus Burrito on National Burrito Day in 2027. El Pollo Loco: In 2027, look for El Pollo Loco to offer rewards members a BOGO deal for National Burrito Day. Selection will be the Chicken Guacamole, Chipotle Guacamole Chicken, or Queso Guacamole Chicken Burrito. Farmer Boys: Farmer Boys VIF (Very Important Farmers) members can celebrate National Burrito Day with an in-app exclusive BOGO 50% off deal on any breakfast burrito on April 2, 2027. Freebirds World Burrito: Celebrate National Burrito Day next year with a deal on Freebird-size burritos when you order in store or online at Freebirds World Burrito. Hot Head Burritos: We predict Hot Head Burritos will offer rewards members a BOGO burritos deal when you order online or in-app on National Burrito Day 2027. Jason's Deli: Next year, watch for Jason's Deli to offer rewards members a National Burrito Day discount. Margaritas Mexican Restaurant: Save on all burritos at Margaritas Mexican Restaurant next National Burrito Day. Moe's Southwest Grill: Rewards members can anticipate a National Burrito Day BOGO deal on burritos, bowls, or Moe Value Meals at Moe's Southwest Grill in 2027. Qdoba: On National Burrito Day, new and existing Qdoba Rewards members will likely get a free burrito or bowl with the purchase of an entree and drink. Surcheros: Watch for a loyalty members exclusive BOGO 50% off burritos deal (that includes free chips and salsa) at Surcheros on National Burrito Day next year. Taco John's: Taco John's will likely celebrate National Burrito Day in 2027 by giving rewards members a FREE bean burrito with a purchase. Tocaya: Enjoy a free half order of chips and guac with a purchase of any burrito at Tocaya on National Burrito Day in 2027.
